# Devang Padhiyar

> Senior Software Engineer at Simplified (production LLM agents; led its AI video team) and Founding Engineer at Scenes AI, a side venture backed by Simplified. Builds LLM agents, video pipelines, and open-source agent infrastructure. Nine years across enterprise ERP, crypto, e-commerce and AI. Based in Ahmedabad, IN (UTC+5:30), remote. Open to remote roles or relocation worldwide.

## Roles

- **Senior Software Engineer — Simplified** (2022–present, remote). Led the AI video team (up to 5 engineers, 577K+ videos); now builds its production LLM agents (VideoPilot, on LangGraph and LangChain Deep Agents). Cut p95 inter-event streaming latency 295 → 69 ms; Celery pipeline at 200K+ jobs a day; 65% less GKE compute.
- **Founding Engineer — Scenes AI** (side venture backed by Simplified, Jan 2026–present). Took an agent-driven AI video studio (React, Django, Mastra) from 0 to 1 as its only engineer: 1,400+ sign-ups and 159 paying customers in 8 months.

## Products I've shipped

- **Scenes AI** (https://usescenes.com) — serialized AI video generation: mini-dramas, shorts, tutorials from a prompt. Consistency across episodes via 4-view character sheets and named location anchors. 13 visual styles, 26 caption styles with word-level timing, 30 voices per engine, up to 4K, SRT/VTT.
- **Simplified Video** (https://simplified.com/ai-video) — text-to-video, AI script and voice generation, voice cloning, multilingual subtitles, long-video repurposing.
- **Monica + Andy** (https://monicaandandy.com) — universal baby registry, Shopify inventory extensions, custom Dwolla payments. Client project via Aubergine Solutions. Role: Senior Engineer.
- **LocalCoinSwap** (https://localcoinswap.com) — non-custodial P2P crypto marketplace; multi-sig BTC-family, smart contracts ETH-family, 300+ payment methods, 190+ countries. Client project via Nividata Consultancy.
- **Progressay** (https://progressay.com) — AI-driven automated essay marking and grading for schools. Client project via Nividata Consultancy. Led the project.
- **Microsoft Dynamics AX** — enterprise ERP: x++, SSRS reports, HRM/AR/AP/Manufacturing/Inventory modules.

## Open source

- **Langrove** (https://github.com/devangpadhiyar/langrove) — author. MIT, Python. Self-hosted, drop-in alternative to LangGraph Cloud: `langgraph_sdk.get_client()` works unmodified, `useStream()` SSE wire format, Agent Protocol. FastAPI + Postgres + Redis Streams, background runs with a DLQ, interrupt/resume, cron, pluggable auth.
- **mastra-ai/mastra** (https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra) — reported 23 durable-execution bugs (all fixed upstream) and authored 6 merged PRs: remote-worker resume (#19713), cross-process tool resolution (#19331), tool-call concurrency (#19329), trace/span nesting (#19313), thread titles (#19315), gcsfuse visibility (#19003).
- **django-durationwidget**, **django-validators** — published Django libraries; 900K+ PyPI downloads (django-durationwidget 815K+).
